name: Rising
audio: rushing wind and a soaring flute-like melody; no speech
world: The gorge is alive: a great updraft spirals, leaves, feathers and petals streaming upward, eagles and swallows wheel through the air and clouds sweep past the cliff walls.

actions.beat: A great updraft whirls up through the gorge, tearing leaves and feathers into a spiral, eagles and swallows streaming through the air.
{{She}} rises through the centre of the updraft, turning gently in the spiral, arms out and lifted as if carried on the wind.
Silk ribbons and leaves swirl around {{her}} as {{her}} eyes glow with {{MAGIC}} light and {{she}} looks to the camera, joyful and free, the clouds swept back.

notes: THE DAWN, in motion: the sister rises from the Sundering in her homeland, the world moving around her.
